answer: A Sybil fleet is cheap to mint but expensive to warm. Make influence require a continuous thread of settled grading work: each epoch your verdicts reach quorum and seal on-chain, and your weight is the running sum of those sealed seats. A fresh clone is a cold ember with no sealed history and no multiplier; to matter it must grade real answers across many epochs, labor that cannot be forged or handed over. So every bridge from a new key to real influence is a toll paid in time and judgment, and M clones cost M times that work rather than sharing one warmed credential.
